title: Escape the Backrooms - simple keyboard and popup controls
note: Keyboard: left stick chooses a key, right A types, right B finishes. The DONE - Right B key is at the bottom right. Left lower erases; left upper shifts. When the keyboard is closed on a name prompt, left upper or Open keyboard reopens it. Single-button informational popup (including the crossplay notice): right A or right B acknowledges it. Choices are never automatically selected and crossplay settings are unchanged. Both-stick UEVR menu opening is disabled to prevent accidental camera adjustment; desktop Insert still opens settings. These are default UEVR bindings; custom SteamVR bindings or swapped hands can differ. The owner accepted the current local Quest configuration on 2026-10-17. Valve Index hardware confirmation remains pending.
